notes: resvg uses manually constructed rounded-rectangle vector, MuPDF renders PDF produced by converting that SVG. Both use 1px per document unit and same target. Alpha L1 over entire frame.
recipe: For each case below, choose a new output basename in /tmp. From the project root run PYTHONPATH=scratch/apk-analysis-runtime/python:tmp/conformance-cleanup/native-capture-a241793/conformance:scratch/defaultpen-native .venv/bin/python tools/marker4_v7/mesa_capture.py --capture-output /tmp/NEW.json --case CASE --scale SCALE --phase-x PHASE_X --phase-y PHASE_Y, then .venv/bin/python tools/marker4_v7/vector_comparison.py /tmp/NEW.json --capture-sha256 SHA256, where SHA256 is obtained with sha256sum /tmp/NEW.json. Never reuse an output basename.
